email.subject: Gentle Co Dentistry: two quick fixes
email.body:
Hi Chloe,

I looked at Gentle Co Dentistry's site. Two things are likely costing you new patients:

1. No online booking - people searching for a Harbor Falls dentist at night or on weekends have no way to grab an appointment, so they just call the next practice.
2. No reviews shown - without visible reviews, new visitors have nothing to confirm you're trustworthy before they call.

I fix these for a flat fee. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what I'd change - no obligation.

Worth a quick look?

Alex
Northlight Web
